summary: A study reported on 3 July 2026 projects that the Grassholm northern gannet colony, one of the world largest, may not recover to pre-outbreak levels until 2041, nineteen years after highly pathogenic avian influenza struck Welsh seabird colonies in 2022. It frames the 2022 to 2024 outbreak as a completed shock with a multi-decade recovery tail.
title: Study projects Welsh seabird colonies may not recover from the 2022 avian flu outbreak until 2041
